# LLMs.txt - Machine-readable information about getffmpeg.org

## Site Information
- Site: getffmpeg.org
- Purpose: FFmpeg Windows distribution and download portal
- Language Support: 12 languages (English, Chinese, Spanish, Arabic, Hindi, Portuguese, Russian, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean)
- Last Updated: 2025-01-11

## Description
This website provides free downloads of FFmpeg for Windows users. FFmpeg is a powerful, versatile multimedia tool that handles decoding, encoding, streaming, and more for almost any format. The site offers an easy-to-use installer and manual installation options.

## Content Structure
- Main download page with installer link for FFmpeg v7.1
- Multi-language support with complete translations
- Links to official FFmpeg documentation and resources
- Manual installation alternatives

## Technical Details
- Current FFmpeg Version: v7.1

- Technology Stack: Static HTML, Tailwind CSS, Google Analytics
- SEO Features: Complete meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, hreflang tags
